text: At revision 1980cfa31c417f178e7dc2d71494ecce20c42864, SearchBar.focus() focuses the actual input inside the shadow root and selects its text when the value is nonempty. Callers using this method therefore let the next typed text replace the existing query. An empty input receives focus without text selection. This is observed source behavior for this widget and revision, not a general focus convention or runtime validation.
title: Search bar focus selects the existing term
